Educational Requirements

Bachelor of Engineering

Service Line

Information Systems

Responsibilities
Design and implement Generative AI solutions using LLMs (GPT, Llama, etc.)
Build and optimize prompt engineering frameworks and AI pipelines
Develop AI-powered applications using Python, LangChain, and relevant frameworks
Integrate GenAI solutions with enterprise systems and APIs
Fine-tune and deploy models across cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP)
Ensure scalability, performance, and responsible AI practices
Collaborate with cross-functional teams for solution delivery
Additional Responsibilities
Experience: 12-15 Years
Relevant Experience: 3+ Years in GenAI/AI/ML
Location: Bangalore
Technical and Professional Requirements
3-4 years of hands-on experience in GenAI / AI / ML
Strong knowledge of LLMs, NLP, deep learning concepts
Expertise in Python, AI frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow)
Experience with LangChain, vector databases, RAG architectures
Good understanding of cloud platforms (Azure OpenAI preferred)
Experience in API integrations and microservices architecture
Experience with fine-tuning models and embeddings
Exposure to MLOps tools and deployment pipelines
Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills
Preferred Skills
Technology->AI-Traditional AI->NLP-Speech Analytics
Technology->AI-Data science->Machine Learning
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Conversational AI Platform
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Generative AI - Basic
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Generative AI for Data Analytics
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Prompt Engineering
